scope: Physical upper-floor simple research bench, shared project progress, Intellectual work XP, industrial starting knowledge, prerequisites and recipe gates, save v15 and genuine v14 migration. Controlled tests, ordinary campaigns, browser controls and native runtime remain separate evidence layers.

researchTests.title: starts with the seven industrial technologies and preserves previous releases as legacy unlocked
uses research speed, manipulation, outdoor and temperature factors at 20 TPS
rotates all six footprint cells and the operating position consistently
allows project selection without a bench, but neither progress nor XP appears
gains points then Intellectual XP only after arriving at the operating cell
preserves partial research through switch, stop, save and load
adds simultaneous work at separate benches into one global project
releases finite research sessions without resetting project progress
interrupts research for a newly reachable higher-priority construction job
stops work immediately on drafting and while all research priorities are disabled
does not repeatedly interrupt research for a higher-priority smith without fuel
stops a research job when demolition is designated and dismantles the real bench
completes once across simultaneous workers, clears all jobs and enables the unlock
builds a six-cell research bench from finite carried inputs and cannot overlap it
rejects prerequisite bypass and technology-gated designations at the simulation boundary
migrates authentic v14 bytes without replacing existing skill XP or physical state
rejects malformed progress, inconsistent prerequisite/current, duplicate benches and stale jobs

campaign.scope: Fresh v15 industrial colony. Normal command/step/save/load only; read-only terrain and path queries. Actual forestry, underground ore, upper floor construction, carried bench inputs, working research, normal food/rest, project switch/stop and physical unlocked smithy. No injected knowledge, skills, resources, terrain, needs, positions or clock.

regressions.scope: Fourteen regression commands against the research integration. No full unit rerun. Fresh campaigns earn research via commands and steps; old fixture campaigns retain documented legacy migration.

limitations: Only 12 selected industrial technologies and a simple bench; tribal scenarios, full technology tree, high-tech research, facilities, techprints, books and queue remain absent.

Voxel outdoor rooms map to native outdoor and roomless factors, but proper room role, cleanliness and bookshelves are not simulated. Indoor assumes neutral cleanliness without laboratory classification.

20 TPS keeps work seconds via x3 points/XP; 12000-tick project days remain compressed. Session duration rounds up and periodic scheduling adds up to one second, unlike native Wait2 and general posture waits.
One fresh research colony and the continued weapons/forestry campaigns do not establish long-term balance or population scaling.

Browser checks use actual controls with read-only snapshots and projection helpers, not screen-only inference. The native experiment measured partial research and switch/stop, not full technology completion.
